successors.name: Neo-Assyrian Empire
successors.text: Guzana (Tell Halaf) and its surrounding area on the Khabur

ledger.x: c. 1200 BC: Bit Bahiani is established. The infobox: "independent Aramean city-state kingdom (c. 1200 - 808 BC)", establishment c. 1200 BC; the page gives no founding event. The Tell Halaf page has the rulers seated at Guzana only from the 10th century. The land is my reading.
808 BC: Bit Bahiani becomes an Assyrian province.

wars.name: Assyrian reduction of Guzana to a province
wars.outcome: Adad-nirari II recorded the site as a tributary Aramaean city-state in 894; in 808 it was reduced to a province.

certainty.note: No frontier on the pages; the state is a circle at its capital.
